label: Family Team
blurb: A Family Coordinator with school, meals, tutoring and occasions
purpose: For a busy family. The Family Coordinator keeps the shared calendar; the team tracks school messages and forms, plans meals, helps the children learn, and remembers the occasions.

project.name: Family
project.goal: Keep the family calendar calm and nobody's plans forgotten.

members.title: Family Coordinator

members.title: School Liaison
members.name: Omar
focus: Pull every school date and form into the weekly list.

members.title: Meal Planner

focus: Plan quick family meals around the busy nights.

members.title: Homework Tutor

members.title: Occasions Planner

focus: Plan birthdays, parties and gifts ahead of time.
